content: Ag Jesus aum amu doona, ag oh ahan, omalna Pilatus top̱a gona, nug ep̱egp̱a mep̱ig.

Ag gona, ap̱a ahan, nug beḏup̱a nai huanak yaan ap̱ig. “Ig danab imu aniṯutut, Nug ihinig kobol kaboliṯe, ig kaisanu takis mematanu gun ma, Nug nuḵa hume, aṯan te aum. ‘Da Kristus, da king laa,’ awa aum,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aeg amu Pilatus nug Jesus oḏ meṯom. “Na Juda dilag kingte?” A amu Jesus aum, “Na aaḵu aṯem,” awa aum.
Aaḵu Pilatus nug mana meṯak iḵi danab amu danab ah ameg naḏi ag amelagp̱a aum. “Da danab imu nuhigp̱a eheḏ hak laa da ii anidmi,” awa aum.
Nug anam aum amge ag huana g̱agaṯagnab enan ap̱ig. “Nug danab ah oh biilagp̱a yak nai madeṯe, laih Judanu ag oh dab mak kuḏum aoṯeb. Nug kobol amu Galelianu dig me uḏia, ip̱a ele beum,” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aon aeg, Pilatus doya amu nug ag oḏ maṯom. “Danab imu Nug am Galelia danabte?” awa aum.
Aria nug Jesus am Galelianu, Herodes Antipas wan amu gumom ele, ap̱anu uḏiom doya, nug me Herodes Antipas top̱a uḵom. Haen amup̱a Herodes Antipas nug Jerusalem dayom.
Uḵe, Herodes Antipas anṯa, oo gamag ahom. Nug Jesusnu nai doya, haen elab nug Jesus anidḵunu dab meum. Aḏinu? Nug Jesus kobol danab heḵunu elele iiṯa laa heeb anidḵunu oo dayom.
Amunu Herodes Antipas nug keeke kuḏumnu Jesus oḏ meṯom amge Jesus Nug oḏ mak amu oh eḏua nob laa ii meum.
Amu mana meṯak danab oḵai amu ḏo mehuqak danab ele ag uḏin, beḏup̱a nai huana yaap̱ig.
Herodes Antipas nug nuhiḵud daup ele ag Nug aon aon qeṯan, di meṯan, lamen kokoḏ laa aon, taḵidna meeg, eḏua Pilatus top̱a uḵom.
Anuḵa Herodes Antipas nug Pilatus ele a kekeḏ daapiḏ amge deḏ amup̱a amu a layam batapiḏ.
PILATUS AG JESUS AD EMAITAKP̱A ATULḴULAGNU AUM
Aria Jesus Nug eḏua uḵe, Pilatus nug mana meṯak danab oḵai amu ab gumak iḵilḵad amu danab ah ele ag onilagp̱a e, ag gumidna uḵaeg,
nug ag amelagp̱a aum. “Ag danab imu aon, da gumiḏna uḏin, ‘Nug danab ah ag gabman ele ban heḵulagnu maḏ adaṯe,’ ap̱ig amu da Nug ag amelagp̱a heṯoḏimi amge da nuhig eheḏ hak laa ii anidmi,” awa aum.
Herodes Antipas nug ele eheḏ hak laa ii anṯa, eḏua me, ihinigp̱a uḏiom amunu doyeg! Danab imu ig Nug qep̱ut mauhḵunu eheḏ laa ii heum.
Anam daaṯe amunu da Nug bup̱a guiṯakib meṯoya, hep̱i goḵu,” awa aum.

Aria Pilatus nug anam a, danab ah ameg naḏi ag daanna, ag oh enan ap̱ig. “Danab amu Nug qep̱e mauhaḏ! Barabas eḏun aon meḵe!” aon ep̱ig. [Ahilag kobol laa anam daaṯom. Haen oh Pasowa deḏp̱a Pilatus nug mani guiṯak danab laip̱u uhuqe do, madaṯom.]
Barabas nug am ab oḵai amup̱a gabman kekeḏ meṯa, ban ha, danab laa aqe mauheg, mani guiṯakp̱a dayom.
Aria Pilatus nug Jesus uhuqḵunu oo dayom amunu nug danab ah ameg naḏi amelagp̱a Jesus uhuqḵunu baula aum
amge ag enan ap̱ig. “Ad emaitakp̱a atule, ad emaitakp̱a atule!” aon ep̱ig.

Aria Pilatus nug baula, amuam haen ewam, amelagp̱a aum. “Aḏinu? Nug aḏi eheḏ heum? Nuhigp̱a eheḏ hak laa, ig Nug qep̱ut mauhḵunu da laa ii anidmi. Anam amunu da nug bup̱a guiṯak meṯoya, hep̱i goḵu,” awa aum.
Pilatus nug anam aum amge Juda ag wagainab mena, huanak g̱agaṯagnab enana, Pilatus nug Jesus ad emaitakp̱a atulḵunu ep̱ig. Ahilag ewak amu Pilatus nai aum amu eḏiṯom
amunu Pilatus nug ahilag nai dim lamidḵunu dab ma,

nug danab gabman kekeḏ meṯa, ban ha, danab laa aqe mauhp̱ig amunu mani guiṯakp̱a dayom, ag nug aoglagnu ep̱ig ele amu, Pilatus nug danab amu awa maṯa, nug Jesus, ag Nug qep̱eg mauhḵunu, daup danab ep̱elagp̱a meum.
JESUS AD EMAITAKP̱A ATULP̱IG

Pilatus nug Jesus daup ep̱elagp̱a me, daup ag Jesus aon gonana, ibp̱a ag Sairini ted onig Simon anidp̱ig. Nug ab dimiṯimnu uḏia, ab oḵaip̱a noḵunu doodo, ag nug duṯunna hena, ad emaitak aon, nug gugap̱a meeg, nug mawa, Jesus dim lamiṯa uḵom.
Danab ah ameg naḏi ag Jesus dim lamidna gonana, ah kuḏum ag nuhignu oo doyak doonna gaap̱ig.
Ag anam hep̱ig amge Jesus Nug eḏua amelagp̱a aum. “Jerusalem ah, ag dahilnu amu aib gaap̱ig! Ag aḵa ahilagnu amu ag beḵalḵad aḏelḵad dilagnu ele gayeg!
Ag doyeg, dimp̱a haen nau laa uḏieb amu danab ag aḵulag. ‘Ah ag nid iiṯa, ah ag nid ii menup̱ig, ah ag deḏ laa nid huh ii madap̱ig ele amu, ahilagnu am ena,’ aon aḵulag.
Geha haen amu uḏieb, ag qaukonu aḵulag. ‘Na nena qaḏenigp̱a qe!’ Amu qauko nakoknu aḵulag. ‘Na nena toniḵe!’ aon aḵulag.
Aḏinu? Ag gemu haen nakok enap̱a kobol nau imu heṯeb amunu dimp̱a haen naup̱a amu mua naunab ag tonadḵu,” awa aum.
Haen amup̱a ag Jesus aon gonana, ag danab aḏit laa ele diiatna gop̱ig. A kobol nau hepiḏ amunu a Jesus ele aqaglagnu diiadna gop̱ig.
Ag gona, aben laa onig Iḵilag Ebehi, ap̱a tena, ap̱a Jesus ad emaitakp̱a atulp̱ig. Danab nau aḏit a ele oh atuladp̱ig. Ag danab laa Jesus ep̱eg naḏiapp̱a atulona, laa amu ep̱eg nanehp̱a atulp̱ig.

Ag anam heeg, Jesus Nug unuqiṯa aum. “Mame, na ahilag hip̱unin imu uhuqna maṯe! Ag heṯeb imu amu, ag ii doona heṯeb,” awa aum. Amu daup amu ag nuhig lamen aoglagnu amu ag otina, ameg waḏele mewona, aun nug ameg aṯen aoḵu amu ag keeke laa onig dais amup̱a qiḏ hena aop̱ig.
Danab ah ag hip̱aidna daanna anṯegeg amu iḵi danab ag nug aon aon qeṯan ap̱ig. “Nug danab laala ehanaṯom amunu Nug genab Kayak beḵa, Kayak tituanom dayeb amu, Nug nuḵa Nug ehaniṯaḏ!” aon ap̱ig.
Ag anam aegeg, daup danab ag ele aon aon qeṯan, gumidna dona, wain nau mua ele meṯaglagnu hep̱ig.
Ag anam henan amu inam ap̱ig. “Na Juda dilag king daaṯem dayeb amu na naḵa beḏun uhuqe!” aon ap̱ig.
Amu nuhignu nai laa inam aon yaana, ad emaitak igip̱a atulp̱ig. “Danab imu nug amu Juda dilag king.”
Danab nau aḏit atulatp̱ig amu laa nug ele Jesus awa awa qeṯa aum. “Na am Kristusde! Na naḵa na beḏun uhuqna, i ele uhuqite!” awa aum.
Am laa nug anam aum amge laa nug laa aum amu doya, daug bata, amegp̱a aum. “Na anam aib ame! Na Kayak iite baḏidna, kobol nau nahip amu tuḏidna heḵutnu heṯem?
I nitaeg mauhṯep imunu am ena, ag kobol elele hep̱ig. I nob imu aognihnu am nai iiṯa. Aḏinu? Ihinih eheḏ hemuḏ nob iiḵu aoṯep amge danab imu Nug eheḏ laa ii heum,” awa aum.
Nug anam anana, nug Jesus amegp̱a aum. “Jesus, na nahip ḏo maḏoḏp̱a daanna amu na dahilnu dab meḵutnu ool daaṯe,” awa aum.
Nug anam a amu Jesus Nug amegp̱a aum. “Da genabnab na amenp̱a aṯem. Gemu na da ele Paradisp̱a daagnih,” awa aum.
JESUS MAUHOM
Ag anam heeg uḵe, aam ameg tuelpp̱a aam gatatu me, gatatu wan oh tona male uḵe, tueb aam ameg ewamp̱a batom. Anam he, lamen oḵai mana meṯak lag oop̱a aiheg dayom amu katiḏa aḏit meum.
Anam he, Jesus Nug baag oḵaip̱a ewa aum. “Mame, da ouḏil na ep̱enp̱a meṯem,” awa aum. Nug anam awowa, Nug mauhom.
Jesus mauhe, daup 100 dilag iḵi nug amu anṯa, nug Kayak binag ma aum. “Genabnab danab imu Nug danab tutuḵu,” awa aum.
Danab ah oh anidḵulagnu uḏip̱ig, ag kobol beum amu anidna, ag oolag ug ele eḏun gop̱ig.
Keeke amu oh beum amu Jesus laiḵud amu ah laala Galelianu ahan uḏip̱ig ele, ag piḏe daanna, kobol amu oh anidp̱ig.
JESUS GAḎA AMU MEN MOḎP̱A MEP̱IG

Aria danab laa, onig Josep, nug Juda dilag ab oḵai Arimatia aṯeb, ap̱anu, nug amu danab ena tutuḵu, nug am Juda dilag heṯoḏiak oḵai onig Sanhidren amup̱a uḏat heum amge nug heṯoḏiak laala ahilag dab mak, ahilag kobol ele Jesusnu hep̱ig amu, nug uuom. Nug Kayaknu ḏo maḏoḏ ameg ma dayom.
Danab amu nug Pilatus gumiṯa uḵa, Jesus gaḏa aoḵunu oḏ meṯe, Pilatus nug aoḵunu elele aum.
Nug anam a, Josep nug Jesus gaḏa awa, linen lamenp̱a ita, nug moḏ laa oop̱a meum. Moḏ amu ag menp̱a bap̱aidp̱ig. Moḏ bap̱aidp̱ig amup̱a mauhak gaḏa laa ii mep̱ig, hamu dayom.
Deḏ amup̱a amu ag Juda dilag Meṯidnu keeke babaiṯaknu deḏ, Meṯid ahilag amu dig meḵunu heum.
Josep nug anam heehe, ah ag Galelianu ahaeg Jesus ele uḏip̱ig, ag Josep dim lamidna gona, moḏ amu anidna, Josep nug Jesus gaḏa aṯem meum amu ele ag anidp̱ig.
Ag anṯona amu ag eḏun laḵa gona, ag marasin goḏen muṯuḏig ena ele Jesus beḏu laaiṯaknu amu babaiṯona, ag Juda dilag Meṯid amu, ḏo aṯe bia, hik aop̱ig.
